inspectionSummary.method: Manual visual selection of each supplied reference, followed by rim/face ellipse overlay review. Existing photos and technical visualizations were retained without edits.
inspectionSummary.limitations: Bounds and visible topology describe a photograph or supplier visualization, not verified manufacturing CAD. Angled, obstructed and cropped evidence retains explicit per-record notes and confidence.
